levels.surface: عبد الرحمن بن يزيد بن جابر

notes: needs ruling (rule 11): «قال وجع أبو موسى وجعا ... فقال أنا بريء» is a narrated encounter in which Abu Musa acts and speaks; whether he is the source of the saying or only in the scene is not settled by the rules, so he is not added and the chain stops at Abu Burda
